hero.title: Six steps from first steps to [[school-ready]]
hero.text: Each programme is matched to a child's age and developmental stage and nourishes all eight intelligences through play.

items.name: Toddlers
items.description: A gentle, affectionate start for our youngest learners. Toddlers explore through touch, movement and sound in a safe, cosy space with caring, trained staff.
objectives: Feel safe and settled away from home
Build early speech through songs and sounds

image.alt: Toddler playing with stacking rings and hoops on a soft play mat

items.name: Playgroup
items.tagline: Play is the work of childhood
items.description: Playgroup introduces routines, friendships and curiosity. Children learn to share, follow simple instructions and express themselves in a joyful, play-led setting.

image.alt: Toddler stacking colourful cups on artificial grass outdoors

items.name: Pre-Nursery
items.description: Pre-Nursery builds independence and creativity with art, movement and early pre-literacy and pre-number experiences, always through hands-on play.
objectives: Hold crayons and brushes with growing control

image.alt: Boy finger-painting grapes on an activity sheet

items.name: Nursery
items.description: Nursery brings early literacy, numeracy and speaking confidence together. Children learn through interactive books, stories and stage experiences.
objectives: Speak confidently in front of others

image.alt: Boy touching an interactive alphabet sound book at his desk

items.name: LKG
items.description: LKG deepens reading, writing and number readiness with activity-based projects, theme days and celebrations, with no rote learning.
objectives: Work in groups and share ideas

image.alt: Girl pointing at an Independence Day activity worksheet at her desk

items.name: UKG
items.description: UKG prepares children for the next step of school with strong foundations, clear communication and the confidence to stand up and speak.
objectives: Strengthen reading, writing and maths readiness
Be happy and ready for primary school

image.alt: Child in a blue graduation gown holding a scroll and a certificate
